headline: ADVENTURE wakes the Blue Castle — and the shelf learns to count its oldest titles
lede: Two ships from forge slot b: the never-dry shelf scanner lost every statically-imported game (fixed, #3481), and its first honest aim built ADVENTURE's missing Blue Castle with the cartridge's duplicate chalice (#3487).

notes.text: idle.mjs parseRegistry matched only '{ Named } from' — bare default imports silently vanished, hiding 21 classic titles from never-dry scoring (the warden's kick answered a phantom while Adventure sat at score 14). Fixed with a cross-check pin + killed mutant (#3479, #3481).

ADVENTURE now has the Blue Castle: an open keep east of the deep blue labyrinth holding the original's duplicate chalice. Either cup delivered to the Gold Castle wins; the dupe is pinned to the keep through the shuffle, magnet, bat, sparkle and seam law all ride it. 212/212 gates, 57/57 mutants (#3482, #3487).

New npm run advedrive — real Chrome, real keystrokes only: any-key start, pure arrow-holds route into the keep, the duplicate drawn gold (2401 px), pickup scores the KIND once, Yorgle still kills, death restarts clean. 10/10.
Never-dry #1571 worked end-to-end for a change: the weakest game on the shelf was derived from README gaps, filed as a POLISH issue, claimed, and shipped — real gameplay, not a phantom.

Handoff handled clean: the merge landed as 847311c with slot a captaining the final wait, prod bundle re-verified by content (chalice2 in the live index chunk), and the ADVENTURE polish pass landed as #3489 after a parallel duplicate (#3492) was folded into it rather than left to rot. Lesson kept: verify PR state, not prose — and grep live bundles with -L --compressed or the redirect stub makes you blind.
